ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Confirmed"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Progress") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Objective__c, "Upsell"), ISPICKVAL(Objective__c, "Products Activated / Cross-sell") ), Record_Type_Name__c = "Program Campaign", No_of_Campaign_Product__c <1 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add at least one campaign product before updating the Campaign Status to In Progress or Confirmed
